semiconductor_relevance: High — RIKUTEC Asia LLC specializes in ultra-clean packaging systems specifically designed for the safe storage and transport of high-purity chemicals used in the semiconductor industry.
summary: RIKUTEC Asia LLC manufactures ultra-clean packaging systems that ensure maximum purity and process safety for high-purity chemicals in the semiconductor sector. Their products, including multilayer HDPE containers and reusable drums, are engineered to meet stringent purity requirements and are suitable for hazardous liquid chemicals.
capabilities: Reusable double-walled drums for hazardous chemicals
technical_expertise: Material science for chemical resistance and durability
